The ein_relation column list, named once

Source: R/md-ingest-relations.R
dot-md_relation_cols.Rd

Every ingest that writes ein_relation used to do it by positional INSERT ... SELECT. That works until the table gains a column, at which point all of them write the new column silently and wrongly - the failure is a shifted value, not an error. Adding controlled_512 forced the fix, and the fix is to name the columns.

Usage

.md_relation_cols(extra = NULL)

Arguments

extra

Columns this particular writer supplies beyond the common set.

Value

A comma-separated column list for an INSERT.

Details

Naming them in each ingest separately would recreate the same drift one level up, so the list lives here and every writer calls this. A future column is added in two places - the CREATE TABLE in md_ingest_relations() and this vector - and every ingest keeps working.
